name: qinglong-admin
description: Full-surface administrator tooling for a Qinglong (青龙 2.x) scheduled-task panel: tasks, subscriptions, environment variables, scripts, configuration files, logs, dependencies, system settings, dashboard, applications and users. Ships a zero-dependency CLI plus an MCP server that reaches every documented route (143), with the panel's field-level references and operational pitfalls distilled into a bundled skill.

panel_url.description: Panel root URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:15700 or https://ql.example.com. Do not append /open. It must be reachable from the machine running the plugin. Also settable via the QL_URL environment variable.

access_token.description: Optional application or session token (Bearer). Tokens live 30 days and are not auto-refreshed in this mode. Leave empty to use client_id + client_secret instead, which the plugin exchanges for a token on demand and refreshes on 401. Also settable via QL_ACCESS_TOKEN.

client_id.description: Application client_id from 面板 系统设置 → 应用设置. Used only when access_token is empty. Also settable via QL_CLIENT_ID.

client_secret.description: Application client_secret. Treated as a secret: stored in the plugin settings, never printed. Also settable via QL_CLIENT_SECRET. Grant the scopes you need (crons, envs, subscriptions, scripts, configs, logs, dependencies, system, dashboard, apps, user).

timeout_ms.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Raise it for slow panels or long-running reads.
